'''Michael C. Pirrung''' (born 1955)<ref>{{Citation|title=Directory of Graduate Research|page=161|publisher=American Chemical Society|author=American Chemical Society. Committee on Professional Training|date=2005}}</ref> is an American [[Organic chemistry|organic chemist]]. He is a [[distinguished professor]] in the department of [[chemistry]] at the [[University of California, Riverside]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://profiles.ucr.edu/app/home/profile/michaelp|title=Michael C. Pirrung|work=[[University of California, Riverside]]|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://chem.ucr.edu/people/faculty|title=Faculty: Chemistry|work=[[University of California, Riverside]]|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref>

In 1995, Pirrung was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=pirrung&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=July 30, 2026}}</ref>
